messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: hosted-runtime eu-west-2 cluster seeing repeated kvcache OOMs (kvcache_alloc_failed). Rate ~12/min. Root at 2032112345

Alex: I'm up. quick glance shows continuous-batcher queue length exploded and per-node in-memory kv cache jumped. Node r-w2-a-4 shows 0.9 -> 3.8x memory in 3m.

Maria: Tracing shows prefetch clients with huge context windows. One tenant (acct: acme-analytics) had a batch job sending concatenated prompts; header `X-Context-Tokens` reports >180k tokens.

Ryan: Noting recent change: rollout at 2032106000 tweaked batching 'elastic_agg' logic to be less conservative. Looks like it allowed prefix aggregation without enforcing max_seq limit.

Sasha: Logs from router show prefetch=true and `allow_kv_expand` flagged. Also seeing `prefetch_retry` loop for some sessions.

Alex: Immediate actions: 1) disable kvcache prefetch in eu-west-2 2) set eviction policy to 'panic' (short-term aggressive) 3) set router hard cap max_batch_seq=65536 4) throttle requests with context>100k tokens at the edge.

Maria: Applying flag flip now. Commands:
```
POST /api/runtime/regions/eu-west-2/flags {"kvcache_prefetch_enabled": false}
POST /api/runtime/regions/eu-west-2/config {"kvcache_eviction":"panic"}
POST /api/router/config {"max_batch_seq":65536}
```
Responses: all 200. Router leader accepted config.

Devops-bot: Canary deployment of flag change scheduled. CI green.

Maria: After toggles: kv_cache_gb on affected nodes trending down, batch queue length halved. OOMs dropped to 0 within ~90s.

Ryan: I'll revert the elastic_agg change and open a hotfix PR to enforce absolute caps inside the batcher loop. PR #4531.

Emily: Customer impact check: acme-analytics saw sustained 5xx for ~12m and elevated latency for additional ~6m due to retries. Two small customers reported brief errors. No logs indicate data persisted from KV cache to disk.

Alex: Confirm: KV cache is memory-only, ephemeral. Still flagging for privacy review but low risk.

Sasha: Restarted r-w2-a-4 to reclaim memory after eviction didn't drop it fast enough. Restart completed OK.

Devops-bot: Restart executed at 2032112502 by Maria. Healthcheck PASS.

Maria: Adding temporary alert: kvcache_node_gb > 48 OR OOM_rate > 0 -> page. Rule created.

Alex: Handoff to Sasha for follow-ups: merge PR, add rate-limiter for context length, postmortem timeline, and coordinate customer comms with Emily.

Sasha: Taking ownership. I'll schedule a postmortem sync and loop in account.team for acme-analytics.

Emily: Drafting customer status message. Will wait for final postmortem language before sending.

Alex: Good work. Closing active pager — cluster stable for 15m. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Will create a short runbook entry for prefetch flags and add a canary with context-length gating.

— end of thread
